answer_1.quote: Llama-3.3 was used with prompt tuning on 10% of the private dataset... to de-identify clinical notes.

answer_2.quote: We used existing evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score). We also present two metrics, one existing and one novel, to evaluate how much LLM result in CRC.

answer_3.quote: Paired chunks are presented to a Llama 3 model which is prompted to classify "whether the deidentified sentence chunk has altered any clinically meaningful information".

answer_4.quote: Each change was manually reviewed by a computer scientist and a physician to determine whether its removal resulted in CRC... we provided detailed written guidelines... physicians then assessed each CRC to determine if the clinical impact ... was high or low.
answer_4.guideline: Detailed written guidelines for annotators to label clinically relevant changes and assign high/low severity.
